protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers, one record per visited class
protocol.meter: one global counter in instructions; the meter exists before the first table entry; table, code, each worker start, each walk step (guard-aware), each key build, each dictionary probe, each record serialize+insert, each collision replay and each candidate verification ask fits() before acting; a replay/verify that does not fit ABANDONS that worker; 32 squarings abort.
protocol.abort: K_STALL=32 consecutive squarings, armed by a guard admission

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W, exact integer check (20000^10000 * 2^n >= W^10000); n-1 asserted to fail
claim.v25_flaw: v25 published floor(log2(W/C)) and checked 2^claim <= W/C, a LOWER bound presented as an upper bound; v26 inverts the direction

row_derivations.walk_steps: steps x STEP; STEP = f_mul x MUL_CHARGE + (1-f_mul) x SQR_CHARGE, f_mul measured on protocol traffic
row_derivations.per_step_lookup_key_and_probe: steps x 646 Ir = state_key48 span (493) + dict_lookup span (153), both disassembled from scripts/ir26/dict26.c
row_derivations.record_writes_and_insert: steps x 934 Ir = 688 serialized bytes (48 B key + 32 A + 32 D + 576 y) + dict_insert span (246)
row_derivations.collision_processing: ceil(S(S-1)/(2N)) x 4096 Ir; 2 matches expected; every match, including a failed shift, is charged
row_derivations.trap_waste_bound: S x (3/7680000 x 32 + (1-f_mul)^32 x 32) x STEP: rule-of-three admission bound on protocol traffic times the EXECUTED abort delay, plus the normal-run bound
row_derivations.index_slots_one_per_record: S index slots x 8 words x 1 Ir: the store holds ONE SLOT PER VISITED RECORD (not the fixture's Rg slots), so a hit resolves through the entry's record word into the A,D,y pool; the Rg=65536 table is a fixture-only charge and is not the production store

charges.price_source: scripts/ir26/count via otool -tvV (dict symbols) and scripts/ir25/count_ir.py (kernels); nothing is priced by notation

dictionary.structure: open addressing, four probes, stride 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15, seven-word entries (six key words + tag), eviction of the smallest leading key word when all four probes are occupied
dictionary.v25_flaw: v25 priced lookup_probe (two probes, int return, no insert, no overflow, no load factor) while citing a full-store dictionary and a key builder Group.state did not use

protocol_traffic.word_family: balanced alternating slot words of lengths 4, 6, 8 (v25) and 4..12 (v26 rerun)

mechanism_existence_proof.label: MECHANISM EXISTENCE PROOF, not a coverage measurement
mechanism_existence_proof.note: the forced branch now calls Group.step(branch=True), so each stall step really runs cyclo_sqr on y and doubles A,D; the delay is the number of EXECUTED steps to the 32-squaring abort

survival.note: the Rg=65536 arm is MEASURED at rp=521041 only (400 pairs); it is not claimed for the second fixture scale, and the residual envelope of the gap fit (band_factor) is charged into success rather than assumed

success.statement: success_final is the CP-95 lower endpoint of the protocol census (512 fixtures per group, one Bernoulli each) times the measured gap-1 survival at production Rg, divided by the fit residual envelope; no extrapolated point estimate is used uncharged

tie_analysis.resolution: kappa = ks.index(min(ks)) is the FIRST minimum (deterministic); the pool slot is derived from sorted(ks), invariant to which rotation attains the minimum, so a tie cannot fork the table index or the record key.
